title: deterministic-refactor.yaml
description: dr's config keys at the repo root, in deterministic-refactor.yaml or, in a repo using la, in living-architecture.yaml. Every key is optional in the schema; absent keys take their defaults, and the format check requires format.

format.description: The file's format: the release that introduced it. Every command but the exempt ones refuses any other format.

exempt.description: Repo-relative fnmatch globs naming paths that are not the repo's own source (fixtures, generated code): language detection leaves them out and the conventions gate exempts them.

test.description: The repo's full non-integration test command.

typecheck.description: dr-typecheck's checker per language, run without a shell from the repo root; null turns the language off. Setting a language forces it on.

python.description: A basedpyright-compatible command: it must accept --writebaseline and keep its baseline at .basedpyright/baseline.json. It must run a verified basedpyright (languages.yaml checker_patch_versions) under Node and keep NODE_OPTIONS, so la can apply the pyright#11919 patch.

typescript.description: A tsc-compatible command; --pretty false is appended.

moved_module_stub.description: The text `dr-refactor rename --stub REMOVAL` leaves at a renamed Python module's old path; {old} and {new} (dotted module names) and {removal} are replaced.

string_forms.description: Patterns for strings that carry a symbol's name (a mini-language such as Cypher): `dr-refactor` respells the one capturing group's text when a class or another module-level symbol of that name is renamed. Each pattern uses the portable regex subset and holds exactly one capturing group.
